notes.content: The CSU Bakersfield Biology curriculum emphasizes hands-on inquiry-based learning. Courses offered cover a broad spectrum of biological diversity, including animal, plant, and microbiology. Undergraduate Biology majors choose the courses that interest them most and may select an area of emphasis in either botany, zoology, cellular and molecular biology, environmental, or pre-professional biology. The field of Biology is interdisciplinary, and our curriculum reflects that by integrating studies in chemistry, mathematics, computer science, and other related subjects. For additional information, visit the following: Department of Biology Program Requirements - Biology, BS

notes.content: Students who have taken Biology or Chemistry coursework should check the Articulation Agreement by the Department of the respective community colleges. The agreement may articulate differently, and it may determine whether the entire Biology and/or Chemistry sequence needs to be completed to receive appropriate course credit for the major requirements at CSUB. A modification to the standard GE program has been approved that allows the possibility of satisfying some GE requirements through the major. BIOL 2010 or BIOL 2110 satisfies B2, MATH 1050 or higher satisfies B4, and CHEM 1000 satisfies B1.
